def typical_against(rows: Sequence[dict], source: str, measures: Sequence[str]) -> dict: 
1311def typical_against(rows: Sequence[dict], source: str, measures: Sequence[str]) -> dict:
1312    """Each summer model against winter's bends, tree by tree, on measures pooled together (one row per tree
1313    and measure): the median ``|summer − winter|`` per model, and the bends with the typical shape against the
1314    bends with the plane as the prior's mean.
1315
1316    Args:
1317        rows: Pass 2's rows (:func:`typical_summer`).
1318        source: The summer source.
1319        measures: The measures pooled.
1320
1321    Returns:
1322        ``{"n", "median": {model: ...}, "closer", "wilcoxon_p"}``: ``closer`` is the share of pairs where
1323        ``bent typical`` is nearer winter than ``bent``.
1324    """
1325    from scipy import stats
1326
1327    win = {(r["tree"], m): r[m] for r in rows if r["source"] == "winter" and not r.get("error") for m in measures}
1328    got = {}
1329    for r in rows:
1330        if r["source"] == source and not r.get("error"):
1331            for m in measures:
1332                got[(r["tree"], m, r["model"])] = r.get(m, float("nan"))
1333    keys = [k for k in win if np.isfinite(win[k]) and all(np.isfinite(got.get((*k, md), np.nan)) for md in SUMMER_MODELS)]
1334    if len(keys) < 3:
1335        return {"n": len(keys)}
1336    err = {md: np.array([abs(got[(*k, md)] - win[k]) for k in keys]) for md in SUMMER_MODELS}
1337    d = err["bent"] - err["bent typical"]
1338    return {"n": len(keys), "median": {md: float(np.median(e)) for md, e in err.items()},
1339            "closer": float(np.mean(d > 0)), "wilcoxon_p": float(stats.wilcoxon(d).pvalue) if np.any(d != 0) else 1.0}

Each summer model against winter's bends, tree by tree, on measures pooled together (one row per tree and measure): the median |summer − winter| per model, and the bends with the typical shape against the bends with the plane as the prior's mean.

Arguments:
  • rows: Pass 2's rows (typical_summer()).
  • source: The summer source.
  • measures: The measures pooled.
Returns:

{"n", "median": {model: ...}, "closer", "wilcoxon_p"}: closer is the share of pairs where bent typical is nearer winter than bent.

TYPICAL_RULE = {'source': 'U-Net', 'tests': {'trunk': ('trunk_out',), 'leader tilts': ('left_tilt', 'right_tilt')}}

The rule fixed before the 449-tree run: model3d uses the typical shape as the prior's mean if, with the U-Net's masks and the shape learnt out of fold, the bends with it are nearer winter's than the bends with the plane as the mean on more than half of the trees with Wilcoxon p < 0.05, on the trunk's angle out of the V's plane and on the leaders' tilts on their stretch (both leaders pooled).

def summarise_typical(rows: Sequence[dict], shapes: dict) -> dict: 
1349def summarise_typical(rows: Sequence[dict], shapes: dict) -> dict:
1350    """The typical-shape run's report: the shape, each model against winter, and the rule's verdict.
1351
1352    Args:
1353        rows: Pass 2's rows (:func:`typical_summer`).
1354        shapes: From :func:`fold_shapes`.
1355
1356    Returns:
1357        The report (``docs/results/bend3d_typical/report.json``), with the rule's verdict.
1358    """
1359    report = {"shape": shapes["all"], "n_trees": len({r["tree"] for r in rows if r["source"] == "winter"}),
1360              "summer": {}}
1361    for source in ("U-Net", "hand masks"):
1362        report["summer"][source] = {
1363            "measures": {m: typical_against(rows, source, (m,)) for m in TYPICAL_MEASURES},
1364            **{name: typical_against(rows, source, ms) for name, ms in TYPICAL_RULE["tests"].items()}}
1365    verdicts = {}
1366    for name in TYPICAL_RULE["tests"]:
1367        t = report["summer"][TYPICAL_RULE["source"]][name]
1368        verdicts[name] = bool(t.get("n", 0) >= 3 and t["closer"] > 0.5 and t["wilcoxon_p"] < 0.05)
1369    report["rule"] = {"tests": verdicts, "adopt": all(verdicts.values())}
1370    report["failed"] = {s: sorted({r["tree"] for r in rows if r["source"] == s and r.get("error")})
1371                        for s in ("winter", "hand masks", "U-Net")}
1372    return report

The typical-shape run's report: the shape, each model against winter, and the rule's verdict.

Arguments:
  • rows: Pass 2's rows (typical_summer()).
  • shapes: From fold_shapes().
Returns:

The report (docs/results/bend3d_typical/report.json), with the rule's verdict.

def typical_lines(report: dict) -> list[str]: 
1375def typical_lines(report: dict) -> list[str]:
1376    """The typical-shape run's report as text.
1377
1378    Args:
1379        report: From :func:`summarise_typical`.
1380
1381    Returns:
1382        The lines of text.
1383    """
1384    out = [f"The typical winter shape ({report['n_trees']} development trees; median bend behind the tree's plane, cm):"]
1385    for part in PARTS:
1386        sh = report["shape"][part]
1387        st, b = np.array(sh["stations"]), np.array(sh["bend"]) * 100
1388        if not len(st):
1389            continue
1390        picks = [i for i in range(0, len(st), 10)] + ([len(st) - 1] if (len(st) - 1) % 10 else [])
1391        out.append(f"  {part:5s} (to {st[-1]:.2f} m): " + ", ".join(f"{st[i]:.1f} m {b[i]:+.1f}" for i in picks))
1392    out += ["", "Summer against winter's bends, tree by tree: median |summer - winter| for each model (degrees; bows "
1393                "cm); the bends with the typical shape against the bends with the plane as the prior's mean "
1394                "(share nearer winter, Wilcoxon p). The shape is learnt without the tree's own fold."]
1395    for source, s in report["summer"].items():
1396        out.append(f"  {source}:")
1397        out.append(f"    {'measure':18s} {'n':>4s} " + " ".join(f"{m:>13s}" for m in SUMMER_MODELS) + "   nearer      p")
1398        for name, a in list(s["measures"].items()) + [(k, s[k]) for k in TYPICAL_RULE["tests"]]:
1399            if a.get("n", 0) >= 3:
1400                out.append(f"    {name:18s} {a['n']:4d} " + " ".join(f"{a['median'][m]:13.2f}" for m in SUMMER_MODELS)
1401                           + f"   {a['closer']:5.0%}  {a['wilcoxon_p']:.1e}")
1402    r = report["rule"]
1403    out += ["", "The rule fixed before the run (U-Net masks; nearer on more than half of the trees, p < 0.05, on the "
1404                "trunk and on the leaders' tilts): " + ", ".join(f"{k} {'passes' if v else 'fails'}"
1405                                                                for k, v in r["tests"].items())
1406            + f" -> {'ADOPT: model3d uses the typical shape' if r['adopt'] else 'not adopted: model3d keeps the plane as the mean'}",
1407            "Failed planes: " + "; ".join(f"{s} {len(t)} ({', '.join(t) or 'none'})" for s, t in report["failed"].items())]
1408    return out

1625    """Write rows, floats to 6 significant digits.

def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int: 
1662def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
1663    """Fit the development trees' bends; choose the prior; compare the seasons; print and save.
1664
1665    Args:
1666        argv: Command-line arguments; ``None`` reads ``sys.argv[1:]``.
1667
1668    Returns:
1669        The exit status: 0 on success, 1 if no development tree with winter clicks was found or an output file
1670        could not be written; with ``--typical``, that of :func:`typical_main`.
1671    """
1672    import argparse
1673    import json
1674    import os
1675    import time
1676    from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
1677    from pathlib import Path
1678
1679    from treeskel.guided_gt import load_clicks
1680    from treeskel.io import index_dataset
1681    from treeskel.segment import hand_mask, load_masks
1682    from treeskel.summer_gt import load_overlays
1683
1684    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m treeskel.bend3d", description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
1685    ap.add_argument("data_dirs", nargs="*", help="dataset folder(s)")
1686    ap.add_argument("--clicks", default="annotations/winter_clicks.json", help="the winter clicks")
1687    ap.add_argument("--mask-overlay", default="annotations/mask_overlay.json", help="the hand masks' line-up")
1688    ap.add_argument("--unet", default="docs/results/segment_lined_up_joined/predicted_masks.npz",
1689                    help="the named U-Net's development masks (5 folds)")
1690    ap.add_argument("--split", default="splits.json", help="its test rows are never loaded; its folds group rows")
1691    ap.add_argument("--out", default="docs/results/bend3d")
1692    ap.add_argument("--trees", nargs="+", help="only these trees (results go to outputs/bend3d_partial)")
1693    ap.add_argument("--jobs", type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 1)
1694    ap.add_argument("--from-saved", metavar="DIR", help="re-summarise a saved run's cv.csv and trees.csv (no images)")
1695    ap.add_argument("--figure", default="docs/figures/bend3d.png", help="the summary figure ('' for none)")
1696    ap.add_argument("--profiles", nargs="+", metavar="TREE", help="also draw these trees' winter profiles")
1697    ap.add_argument("--profiles-figure", default="docs/figures/bend3d_profiles.png")
1698    ap.add_argument("--typical", action="store_true",
1699                    help="the typical winter shape as the prior's mean: learn it, and compare summer with it "
1700                         "(-> docs/results/bend3d_typical/, docs/figures/bend3d_typical.png)")
1701    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
1702    if args.typical:
1703        return typical_main(args)
1704
1705    split = json.loads(Path(args.split).read_text())
1706    fold_rows = split["fold_val_rows"]
1707    failed: list[str] = []
1708    if args.from_saved:                                  # only the summary again, from the saved rows
1709        out = Path(args.out if args.out != "docs/results/bend3d" else args.from_saved)
1710        cv_rows, rows = load_csv(Path(args.from_saved) / "cv.csv"), load_csv(Path(args.from_saved) / "trees.csv")
1711    else:
1712        if not args.data_dirs:
1713            ap.error("give the dataset folder(s), or --from-saved")
1714        test_rows = set(split["test_rows"])
1715        clicks = load_clicks(args.clicks)
1716        records = {t.tree_id: t for d in args.data_dirs for t in index_dataset(d).trees if t.row not in test_rows}
1717        ids = sorted(t for t in records if t in clicks and not clicks[t].skip and clicks[t].complete
1718                     and (not args.trees or t in args.trees))
1719        if not ids:
1720            print("No development-row trees with winter clicks found; nothing to measure.")
1721            return 1
1722        # A run on chosen trees goes to outputs/, so it never overwrites the committed full run.
1723        out = Path(args.out if not args.trees or args.out != "docs/results/bend3d" else "outputs/bend3d_partial")
1724        workers = max(1, min(args.jobs, len(ids)))
1725
1726        def run(fn, jobs, what):
1727            """Map ``fn`` over ``jobs`` in worker processes, printing progress."""
1728            t0, step, res = time.time(), max(1, min(25, len(jobs) // 10)), []
1729            with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as ex:
1730                for i, r in enumerate(ex.map(fn, jobs, chunksize=1), 1):
1731                    res.append(r)
1732                    if i % step == 0 or i == len(jobs):
1733                        el = time.time() - t0
1734                        print(f"  {what}: {i}/{len(jobs)} trees, {el:.0f} s elapsed, about "
1735                              f"{el / i * (len(jobs) - i):.0f} s left", flush=True)
1736            return res
1737
1738        # Phase 1: every tree's winter block cross-validation over the grid of priors.
1739        print(f"Phase 1: block cross-validation of the winter depth on {len(ids)} development trees "
1740              f"({len(GRID)} priors and the plane)...", flush=True)
1741        results = run(cv_tree, [(records[t], clicks[t]) for t in ids], "phase 1")
1742        cv_rows = cv_table(results)
1743        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1744        save_csv(out / "cv.csv", cv_rows)
1745        cv_rows = load_csv(out / "cv.csv")
1746        # The rule fixed before the run: the prior with the smallest pooled left-out error.
1747        params = params_of(choose(cv_rows))
1748        print(f"Chosen prior: {setting_key(params)}", flush=True)
1749
1750        # Phase 2: the chosen prior on every tree: winter (every camera setting), the hand mask, the U-Net's mask.
1751        overlays = load_overlays(args.mask_overlay)
1752        unet = load_masks(Path(args.unet)) if Path(args.unet).exists() else {}
1753        radii = {r["tree"]: r["radii"] for r in results}
1754        jobs = [(records[t], clicks[t], radii[t], hand_mask(records[t], overlays), unet.get(t), params) for t in ids]
1755        print(f"Phase 2: the chosen prior on {len(ids)} trees, winter and summer...", flush=True)
1756        rows = [r for rs in run(measure_tree, jobs, "phase 2") for r in rs]
1757        save_csv(out / "trees.csv", rows)
1758        rows = load_csv(out / "trees.csv")              # the report from the saved rows, so it reproduces
1759
1760        if args.profiles:
1761            panels = []
1762            for t in args.profiles:
1763                if t not in records or t not in clicks:
1764                    print(f"  {t}: not a development tree with clicks; no profile")
1765                    continue
1766                images, sk = winter_skeleton(records[t], clicks[t])
1767                try:
1768                    prep = prepare(sk["paths"], images["depth"], images["valid"], sk["radii"])
1769                except ValueError as e:
1770                    print(f"  {t}: {e}")
1771                    continue
1772                fit = fit_bends(prep, params)
1773                panels.append((f"{t} winter", prep, fit, posterior_sd(fit)))
1774            if panels:
1775                plot_profiles(panels, Path(args.profiles_figure), failed,
1776                              f"Winter depth along the branches and the fitted bends ({setting_key(params)})")
1777
1778    report = summarise(cv_rows, rows, fold_rows)
1779    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1780    (out / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
1781    lines = report_lines(report)
1782    print("\n".join(lines))
1783    try:
1784        (out / "output.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
1785    except OSError as e:
1786        failed.append(f"{out / 'output.txt'}: {e.strerror or e}")
1787    if args.figure:
1788        Path(args.figure).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1789        plot_figure(cv_rows, rows, fold_rows, Path(args.figure), failed)
1790    print(f"\nSaved cv.csv, trees.csv, report.json and output.txt in {out}"
1791          + (f", and {args.figure}" if args.figure else ""))
1792    for f in failed:
1793        print(f"Could not write {f}")
1794    return 1 if failed else 0

Fit the development trees' bends; choose the prior; compare the seasons; print and save.

Arguments:
  • argv: Command-line arguments; None reads sys.argv[1:].
Returns:

The exit status: 0 on success, 1 if no development tree with winter clicks was found or an output file could not be written; with --typical, that of typical_main().

def run_parallel(fn, jobs: Sequence, what: str, workers: int) -> list: 
1797def run_parallel(fn, jobs: Sequence, what: str, workers: int) -> list:
1798    """Map ``fn`` over ``jobs`` in worker processes, printing progress, in the jobs' order.
1799
1800    Args:
1801        fn: A top-level function of one job.
1802        jobs: The jobs.
1803        what: What the progress lines call the step.
1804        workers: Most worker processes.
1805
1806    Returns:
1807        ``fn``'s results, in the order of ``jobs``.
1808    """
1809    import time
1810    from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
1811
1812    t0, step, res = time.time(), max(1, min(25, len(jobs) // 10)), []
1813    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, min(workers, len(jobs)))) as ex:
1814        for i, r in enumerate(ex.map(fn, jobs, chunksize=1), 1):
1815            res.append(r)
1816            if i % step == 0 or i == len(jobs):
1817                el = time.time() - t0
1818                print(f"  {what}: {i}/{len(jobs)} trees, {el:.0f} s elapsed, about {el / i * (len(jobs) - i):.0f} s left",
1819                      flush=True)
1820    return res

def typical_main(args) -> int: 
1827def typical_main(args) -> int:
1828    """``--typical``: learn the typical winter shape and compare summer with it (development rows only).

1830    Pass 1 fits every development tree's winter bends with the chosen prior (``docs/results/bend3d/report.json``)
1831    and samples them along each part; the typical shape is learnt from all trees and, for each fold, from the
1832    other folds' trees. Pass 2 fits summer (the lined-up hand mask and the U-Net's mask) with the plane and with
1833    the out-of-fold typical shape as the prior's mean. The rule (:data:`TYPICAL_RULE`) decides whether
1834    :mod:`treeskel.model3d` uses the shape.
1835
1836    Args:
1837        args: The parsed command line of :func:`main`.
1838
1839    Returns:
1840        The exit status: 0 on success, 1 if no development tree with winter clicks was found or an output file
1841        could not be written, 2 if neither the dataset folders nor ``--from-saved`` was given.
1842    """

1844    from pathlib import Path

1846    from treeskel.guided_gt import load_clicks
1847    from treeskel.io import index_dataset
1848    from treeskel.segment import hand_mask, load_masks

1859        out = Path(args.out if args.out != "docs/results/bend3d" else args.from_saved)
1860    else:
1861        if not args.data_dirs:
1862            print("give the dataset folder(s), or --from-saved")
1863            return 2
1864        chosen = Path("docs/results/bend3d/report.json")

1866        clicks = load_clicks(args.clicks)

1868                   if t.row not in set(split["test_rows"])}

1870                     and (not args.trees or t in args.trees))

1873            return 1

1877        winter = run_parallel(typical_winter, [(records[t], clicks[t], params) for t in ids], "pass 1", args.jobs)
1878        shapes = fold_shapes(winter, fold_rows)

1882        jobs = [(records[t], hand_mask(records[t], overlays), unet.get(t), params,

1884        print(f"Pass 2: summer with the plane and with the typical shape as the prior's mean...", flush=True)

1892                  "trees": len([w for w in winter if w["profiles"] is not None])}

1895                            **{p: np.array([w["profiles"][p] for w in winter if w["profiles"] is not None])

1897    report = summarise_typical(rows, shapes)

--typical: learn the typical winter shape and compare summer with it (development rows only).

Pass 1 fits every development tree's winter bends with the chosen prior (docs/results/bend3d/report.json) and samples them along each part; the typical shape is learnt from all trees and, for each fold, from the other folds' trees. Pass 2 fits summer (the lined-up hand mask and the U-Net's mask) with the plane and with the out-of-fold typical shape as the prior's mean. The rule (TYPICAL_RULE) decides whether treeskel.model3d uses the shape.

Arguments:
  • args: The parsed command line of main().
Returns:

The exit status: 0 on success, 1 if no development tree with winter clicks was found or an output file could not be written, 2 if neither the dataset folders nor --from-saved was given.
